name: Grid

columns.description: Most columns to show, from 1 to 6. The grid uses fewer when they would get narrower than `minColumnWidth`.

gap.description: Spacing between items: `none`, `sm` (8 px), `md` (16 px), or `lg` (24 px).

minColumnWidth.description: Narrowest column before the grid wraps. Use `"sm"` (150 px) for metric tiles and `"md"` (288 px) for panels.
